Since we are requested to not use the built-in `sum` function,
let's first define a helper function which sums the elements of a vector:
```{r}
sumFun <- function(x) {
  sum <- 0
  for (item in x) {
    sum <- sum + item
  }
  sum
}
```

Now, the `varFun` function can be defined as follows:
```{r}
varFun <- function(x) {
  len <- length(x)
  mean <- sumFun(x) / len

  square_error <- sumFun((x - mean)**2)
  variance <- (1 / (len - 1)) * square_error

  print(variance)
}
```

and it can be called to print the variance of the range `6:36`:
```{r}
varFun(6:36)
```
